items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: I played for Caledonia. I played for Patsy.

ctx.x: Yeah. I played for Caledonia. I played for Patsy. And I was the name Patsy, Caledonia. I can't think of the name. That's just the two I can think about. But we had that witness there, man. Traffic cops and everything, each group, man. People coming from all directions wanted to see that. That was just a big money deal. Pack them in like Sardines.
And you're in the boss, you're a committee man for this boss cast, wasn't it?
